_comment: Resource budgets for ad tags. 'error' limits are Chrome Heavy Ad Intervention (do not raise). 'warn' limits are IAB New Ad Portfolio targets and scale by ad size via profiles. See ../references/resource-budgets.md.

cpuTotalSeconds.label: Total main-thread CPU
cpuTotalSeconds.source: Chrome Heavy Ad Intervention (60 s total)

cpuPeakWindowSeconds.label: Peak main-thread CPU in window
cpuPeakWindowSeconds.source: Chrome Heavy Ad Intervention (15 s in any 30 s window)

video-15s._note: Adds the IAB 1.1 MB auto-init 15s video allotment on top of initial load.

video-30s._note: Adds the IAB 2.2 MB auto-init 30s video allotment on top of initial load.

cxr._note: Genuin Contextual Reels inline video unit (~320x100). IAB warn limits use the auto-init 15s video allotment (1.1 MB) since the reel autoplays video on load. HAI error limits are Chrome's and are NOT scaled. The subload request count is raised to reflect HLS segmenting (one request per video chunk), which is inherent to streaming video and not a per-request budget concern.
